title: Control Bootcamp: Overview
summary: The opening lecture of Steve Brunton's Control Bootcamp, covering the kinds of control and why closed-loop feedback matters. It starts a series that follows the control chapter of the Brunton and Kutz data-driven science book.
why: HN recommends the series as an approachable but rigorous way to learn control theory, with good production quality.

quote.text: a sweet lecture series called the Control Bootcamp that dives deep into control fundamentals while still being approachable
